rows: ~9.3M tokens (two whole-repo passes plus repro scripts)
notes_markdown:
- The **45-drift reference set** is the union of what the methods found, so it favours them. Labels were checked against the source by an AI reviewer. The stored field is still `hand_verdict`.
- Beam triage judged **56** candidates and rejected **0** of 32 true candidates, while removing **15** of 24 false or unclear ones. 11 of 12 libraries were triaged; structlog failed; cattrs needed 2 calls.
- **2 false + 1 unclear (werkzeug S38, S39 false; S41 unclear)** received a strict repro badge. The v1 line “10 of 11 reproduce; 0 of 10 false do” is wrong for v2.
- structlog: Beam's triage reply had no JSON, so its 6 candidates are shown untriaged.
- Chunked Beam alone found **11** local docstring/prose drifts the hybrid misses.
- The strict repro rule was set after the first repro run.
- No prompt caching was observed on triage calls (each billed the full ~300–400k pack).
- Hybrid triage-only cost is about **9.2M** tokens (4,424,575 + 4,739,392 = 9,163,967). End-to-end including repro is **9,302,105 (~9.3M)** (4,424,575 + 4,739,392 + 138,138). The cheaper symbol-only-candidate variant was not run.
- The local-file vs whole-repo ablation spent **1,948,469** extra tokens. That ledger is not part of the 9.3M hybrid end-to-end.
- The docs-pass + 32k docstring-chunk extra pass spent **7,713,453** extra tokens. That ledger is not part of the 9.3M hybrid end-to-end.

ablation.claim: Long context didn't make verdicts more accurate here; it made them cite the real evidence across files, which is what we verify and show maintainers.
caveats: n=56 judged candidates (structlog excluded; its hybrid triage failed).
Labels and gold file:line were checked against the source by an AI reviewer, not a human maintainer.
Whole-repo is one batched call per repo; local is one call per candidate.
Local was given every file the candidate already named.
6 of 56 disagreements split 3-3. Stability rerun: 26/27 verdicts matched.

Whole-repo used 4,022,532 tokens vs 830,527 for local (~4.8×). This ablation run's own ledger is 1,948,469 tokens over 60 calls; that is extra experimental cost, not part of the 9.3M hybrid end-to-end.
ablation.subset_note: On the 27-item rerun subset, local-only scored higher on verdict accuracy (0.926 vs 0.815). Whole-repo's advantage is citation: 4/4 vs 0/4 when the proof lives outside the candidate's files.

beamv3.title: Catching what one whole-repo call misses
beamv3.claim: 32k docstring chunks recovered 7 of the 11 drifts hybrid missed; the docs-focused whole-context pass recovered 1; 3 prose-doc drifts are still missed. Union coverage 34 → 42 of 45. Marginal cost ~140k tokens per extra drift for 32k chunks vs ~1.5M for the docs pass. Precision of the new findings is a lower bound: 18.5% for hybrid + 32k-chunk new items (60.0% among labelled); most are unlabelled and are not counted as true. 7 new true drifts sit outside the labelled 45 (checked against the source by an AI reviewer). Stability repeat: 18/19 verdicts agreed.
beamv3.recipe: Recommended: symbol check + whole-repo Beam triage, plus 32k docstring chunks if you want more coverage at lower precision.
rows: Hybrid + v3 new items strict-confirmed by repro
caveats: This is a Benchmark-tab experiment, not a headline number. Headline coverage stays 34 of 45.
Precision LB = labelled-true / all findings. Unlabelled findings are not counted as true.
'Among labelled' is biased upward: the labelled items are the ones that hit known drifts.
15 new-item labels were checked against the source by an AI reviewer at the pack ref, not a human maintainer. Unclear counts as not-true.
3 still-missed drifts are prose-doc: C:attrs-py2-reprs, C:httpx-sslcontext, C:mm-quotes-400.
Whole-repo is one call per repo; the extra pass is one call per 32k Python-docstring chunk; docs is one focused whole-context call per repo.
This run's own ledger is 7,713,453 tokens over 168 calls. That is extra experimental cost, not part of the 9.3M hybrid end-to-end.
The shipped CLI is still symbol check + one whole-repo triage. 32k docstring chunks are an experimental extra pass (`scripts/beamv3.py`), not a `--docstring-chunks` flag.

token_footnote: ~9.2M tokens (two whole-repo passes over 12 libraries). 4,424,575 first sweep + 4,739,392 hybrid triage. +138,138 for repro scripts = 9,302,105 end to end.

pack_coverage.note: truncated: true means the packer hit the remaining-budget cutoff while files were still in the queue. skipped_paths only records binary or undecodable files, so the dropped remainder is not listed.
